subject_context: Every US Submarine Class Ever Built (2026)

new_claims.claim: USS Plunger (SS-2) was classified as an Adder Class Submarine Torpedo Boat.
USS Plunger (SS-2) was built at Crescent Shipyard, Elizabethport, N.J. under subcontract from J.P. Holland's company.
USS Plunger (SS-2) had a displacement of 149 tons surfaced and 168 tons submerged.
USS Plunger (SS-2) conducted a demonstration dive with President Theodore Roosevelt aboard on 25 August 1905, remaining submerged for three hours.
USS Plunger (SS-2) was renamed USS A-1 on 17 November 1911.
USS Plunger (SS-2) was authorized as an experimental target designated Target E on 29 August 1916.
USS Plunger (SS-2) was struck from the Naval Register on 24 February 1913 and sold for scrapping on 26 January 1922.
USS Plunger (SS-2) was commissioned on 19 September 1903 at the Holland Co., New Suffolk, Long Island, NY.
